title: 第17章 抢人大战决赛第18章 抢人大战总决赛
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
刹那间！
众人感受到几股强大的力量传来。
刚离去的吕丹辰，叶青青，霸刀皆是归来。
众人这一次没有看几位，而是看向测试阵法前的一位小姑娘。
小姑娘穿着粉红公主裙，绣花小鞋，年纪七八岁左右，看上去瓷娃娃一样粉嘟嘟的可爱。
其头上扎着一对冲天揪，冲天揪的中间，躺着一只正在酣睡的雪白色小猫咪。
小萝莉面对如此多人的注视。
显得格外拘谨。
通红的小脸红润可爱，扭捏的摆弄着手指不知所措。
七品灵根，修仙界最高级别灵根没有之一。
七品灵根，又被称为地仙。
因为历史一在证明，七品灵根者皆可飞升仙界。
也就是说，眼前的小萝莉，只要好好修行不夭折，必然会飞升仙界，成为仙人。
“小师妹，来我仙鼎峰可好，在仙鼎峰，任何资源随意你使用，若是不够，师兄可亲自替你寻来。”
吕丹辰率先开口。
英俊潇洒的模样，高大俊朗的外形，堪称少女杀手。
小萝莉有些心动。
望着眼前的阳光大哥哥，小心脏哐哐哐乱跳。
“别听他的小丫头，来我千刃峰，任何人胆敢欺负你，我都叫他死无全尸。”
霸刀抱着膀子。

作为刀痴，引诱小萝莉这种事，还不如让他去挥刀一万次来的痛快。
果然。
神仙儿听到死无全尸四个字，立刻露出怕怕的模样。
“霸刀师弟，可不要吓到小师妹啊！”
温柔大姐姐叶青青出手。
顿时让小萝莉的大眼闪出光亮。
“跟姐姐走，姐姐的缥缈峰上都是漂亮小姐姐，想穿什么花衣服都有，至于修行资源，红娘师父会亲自给师妹寻找，还有被人欺负，缥缈峰三千女弟子给你撑腰，谁敢放肆。”
不得不说，叶青青对于这种小萝莉简直毫无抵抗力。
三位年轻一代骄储，为了一个小萝莉，眼看既要撕破脸，针锋相对。
“哈哈哈……我没来晚吧。”
洒脱的大笑声从人群中传来。
一位青年，看上去颇为英俊。
但这走路的姿势却给人一种吊儿郎当的模样。
“这个瘟神，他怎么来了。”
见到此人，孙宝与丁原对视一眼，立刻后退。
“杜明师兄，好久不见。”
content_en:
In an instant!
Everyone felt several powerful forces coming from them.
Lu Danchen, Ye Qingqing, and Ba Dao, who had just left, all returned.
This time, everyone did not look at anyone, but at a little girl in front of the test formation.
The little girl is wearing a pink princess dress and embroidered shoes. She is about seven or eight years old and looks as pink and cute as a porcelain doll.
There is a pair of sky-high knots tied on its head. In the middle of the sky-high knots lies a snow-white kitten that is sleeping soundly.
The little loli faces the attention of so many people.
Seems extremely reserved.
Her red little face was cute and rosy, and she was twiddling her fingers at a loss.
A seventh-grade spiritual root, one of the highest-level spiritual roots in the world of immortality.
The seventh-grade spiritual root is also known as the Earth Immortal.
Because history has proven that anyone with seventh-grade spiritual roots can ascend to the immortal world.
In other words, as long as the little Loli in front of me practices well and does not die prematurely, she will surely ascend to the immortal world and become an immortal.
"Little junior sister, come to our Xianding Peak. At Xianding Peak, you can use any resources at your disposal. If there are not enough, senior brother can personally find them for you."
Lu Danchen spoke first.
With his handsome appearance and tall handsome appearance, he can be called a girl killer.
The little loli was a little moved.
Looking at Brother Sunshine in front of me, my little heart was beating wildly.
"Don't listen to him, little girl. Come to Thousand Blades Peak. Anyone who dares to bully you will be killed without a whole body."
Ba Dao hugged his arms.
As a knife fanatic, seducing a little loli would be more enjoyable than letting him swing the knife ten thousand times.
really.
When Shenxian'er heard the words "death without a complete body", she immediately looked scared.
"Junior Brother Ba Dao, don't scare little Junior Sister!"
The gentle elder sister Ye Qingqing takes action.
Suddenly the little Loli's big eyes shined brightly.
"Follow my sister. My sister's Piaomiao Peak is full of beautiful young ladies. They can wear whatever colorful clothes they want. As for the training resources, Master Matchmaker will personally search for them. If you are bullied, the three thousand female disciples of Piaomiao Peak will support you. Who dares to be presumptuous?"
It has to be said that Ye Qingqing has absolutely no resistance to this kind of little lolita.
Three arrogant young people are about to fight each other over a little Lolita.
"Hahaha... I'm not too late."
Free and easy laughter came from the crowd.
A young man who looked quite handsome.
But the way he walks gives people a careless look.
"This god of plague, why is he here?"
Seeing this person, Sun Bao and Ding Yuan looked at each other and immediately backed away.
"Senior Brother Du Ming, long time no see."
